name: mizan
description: Connect Claude Code to your Mizan Platform company: invoices, purchases, bank reconciliation, TVA/RAS declarations, payroll, month-end close and reports, with Mizan's confirm-before-write safety tiers.

server_url.title: Mizan address

agent_token.title: Agent token
agent_token.description: In Mizan open Découverte → Assistant IA, choose a company and an access level, and copy the token. It is stored in your system keychain.
